ex.en: Over-hunting could lead to the disappearance of the whale population, possibly causing major problems to the global food chain.
ex.zh: 过度捕猎可能导致鲸类种群消失，进而可能给全球食物链造成重大问题。

ex.en: A Google Ngram Viewer chart shows that by 1993 climate change was already more commonly used in books than global warming.
ex.zh: Google Ngram Viewer的一张图表显示，到1993年，“气候变化”在书籍中的使用频率就已高于“全球变暖”。

tip: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。

senses.zh: 视角， 观点； 远景， 景观； 透视画法， 透视图

ex.en: There is also no big difference between organic and non-organic products from a food-safety perspective.
ex.zh: 从食品安全的角度看，有机产品与非有机产品之间也没有很大差别。

ex.en: The most important thing for you to do at first is to understand your role from multiple perspectives.
ex.zh: 你一开始最重要的事，是从多个角度理解自己的角色。

tip: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。
